title: 为视频内容生成文本
description: Get text-driven videos ready to post, without touching a single slider. Upload your text prompts (TXT, DOCX, PDF, MP4, up to 200MB), say something like "generate a script for a 30-second explainer video about our new app", and download 1080p MP4 when it's done. Built for content creators who move fast and need to quickly turn written ideas into video-ready text or narration.
